notes.title: Weapon Pack 1 Completed
notes.notes: All the weapons are already in the mysterious armory of the new scenario La PAU (Episode 2), you can send all those zombies to hell in an easy and comfortable way with the new weapons added in the mysterious armory.

notes.title: New Statge
notes.notes: In this new map you can walk the streets of a cursed town, where you will find the Flowers armory where you can try your luck with weapons and get a very powerful weapon or a useless weapon, you will also have an artifact that will eliminate your enemies for a small price.
